0022600130.text: The Spurs (1-2, 3rd in the Southwest and 2 games back, 10th in the West) host the Sacramento Kings (0-2, 14th in the West, 4th in the Pacific and 2.5 games back) in San Antonio's fourth game of the season. The Spurs are 0-2 at home but 1-0 on the road, and Sacramento has lost both games it has played and is on a two-game losing streak. San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf, strain), while Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf, strain), Keegan Murray (ankle) and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27. The Spurs won all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently 132-104 in Sacramento on March 17, 2026.
